set -e
LIVE=~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc
NODE_PATH=/home/jon/.npm/_npx/c221796ab516dfd3/node_modules node -e '
const fs=require("fs");
const {parse}=require("jsonc-parser");
const src=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");
const errs=[];
const cfg=parse(src,errs,{allowTrailingComma:true});
if(errs.length){console.error("parse errors:",errs);process.exit(2);}
fs.writeFileSync("/tmp/sc-with.json", JSON.stringify(cfg,null,2));
const stripped = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cfg));
delete stripped.mcp["adv-advance"];
fs.writeFileSync("/tmp/sc-without.json", JSON.stringify(stripped,null,2));
console.log("fixtures built: /tmp/sc-with.json (has entry), /tmp/sc-without.json (entry stripped)");
' "$LIVE"

echo
echo "=== GREEN: predicate against /tmp/sc-with.json (should pass, exit 0) ==="
if jq -e --arg name "adv-advance" --arg url "http://localhost:6298/mcp" \
    '(.mcp // {}) | if type == "object" then has($name) and (.[$name].url // "") == $url else false end' \
    /tmp/sc-with.json >/dev/null; then
  echo "GREEN OK: predicate matched (exit 0)"
else
  echo "GREEN FAIL: predicate should have matched but did not"; exit 1
fi

echo
echo "=== RED: predicate against /tmp/sc-without.json (should fail, exit non-0) ==="
if jq -e --arg name "adv-advance" --arg url "http://localhost:6298/mcp" \
    '(.mcp // {}) | if type == "object" then has($name) and (.[$name].url // "") == $url else false end' \
    /tmp/sc-without.json >/dev/null; then
  echo "RED FAIL: predicate should NOT have matched but did"; exit 1
else
  echo "RED OK: predicate correctly rejected missing entry (exit $?)"
fi

echo
echo "=== PATCH: jq patch against /tmp/sc-without.json (should add entry) ==="
jq --arg name "adv-advance" --arg url "http://localhost:6298/mcp" \
    '.mcp = ((.mcp // {}) | . + {($name): {"type": "remote", "url": $url, "enabled": true}})' \
    /tmp/sc-without.json > /tmp/sc-patched.json
if jq -e --arg name "adv-advance" --arg url "http://localhost:6298/mcp" \
    '(.mcp // {}) | if type == "object" then has($name) and (.[$name].url // "") == $url else false end' \
    /tmp/sc-patched.json >/dev/null; then
  echo "PATCH OK: entry added and URL matches"
else
  echo "PATCH FAIL: entry not added correctly"; exit 1
fi

echo
echo "=== cleanup ==="
rm -f /tmp/sc-with.json /tmp/sc-without.json /tmp/sc-patched.json
echo "all TDD phases passed"

# Durable adv-advance MCP registration in deploy-local.sh

## Problem

`registerAdvAdvanceMcpServer` (Concord `TEMPORARY_BRIDGE` row) executed the
opencode.jsonc mcp surface on 2026-07-27 (toolbox change `refreshConcordInventory`),
but the registration is not durable against future Advance plugin re-deploys:

- `~/dev/advance/scripts/deploy-local.sh` already validates and patches several
  ADV entries in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` (plugin path, instructions,
  legacy agent keys) via `check_config()` / `fix_config()`.
- It does NOT currently validate or patch the `adv-advance` entry under `.mcp`.
- Result: any future opencode.jsonc rewrite or fresh install that loses the
  `adv-advance` entry will silently break Tier-4 `tools.adv.*` Code Mode reads
  with no signal at deploy time.

## Scope

Extend `scripts/deploy-local.sh` to validate and patch the `adv-advance` MCP
entry, following the exact existing pattern used for the plugin path and
instructions:

1. Add two constants near the existing path constants:
   - `ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME="adv-advance"`
   - `ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL="http://localhost:6298/mcp"`
2. Add a check in `check_config()` that verifies `.mcp.adv-advance.url` matches
   the expected URL; emit `✓` on match, `✗` with the expected URL on mismatch
   or absence; bump `config_issues` on failure.
3. Add a patch in `fix_config()` (after the plugin-array patch step) that
   inserts the entry when missing. The existing fail-loud JSONC path handles
   the operator-message case; plain JSON gets auto-patched.

## Out of scope

- Mutating the live `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` (the operator already
  has the entry; this change only adds deploy-time enforcement).
- Editing any vision config or MCP server artifact.
- Defining a deprecation path for the bridge (still a `TEMPORARY_BRIDGE`).
- Touching any other script or docs file.

## Verification

- `bash scripts/deploy-local.sh --check` (no flags) reports
  `✓  mcp: adv-advance registered (Tier-4 read surface)` on the operator config
  that already has the entry.
- A deliberately-removed `adv-advance` entry (in a test fixture or dry-run)
  causes `check_config()` to report `✗` and bump `config_issues`.
- `bash scripts/deploy-local.sh --fix --dry-run` against a JSONC config
  missing the entry emits the patch summary line and the manual-edit restore
  hint (no auto-rewrite, matching existing JSONC fail-loud policy).
- `shellcheck` clean on the edited regions (script already passes shellcheck;
  edits must preserve that).

## Notes

- Pattern source: existing `plugin` array check at line 831 and `plugin` patch
  at line 1142 of `scripts/deploy-local.sh`.
- The URL/port 6298 matches the existing vision config in
  `~/.config/vision/servers.yaml` (sibling of episode=6297, lgrep=6278).
- No new spec deltas: this is a deploy-script operational improvement, not a
  product spec change.

# Agreement

## Objective

Extend `~/dev/advance/scripts/deploy-local.sh` to durably validate and patch the
`adv-advance` MCP entry in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc`, following the
existing pattern used for the ADV plugin path and global instructions.

## Success Criteria

- `bash scripts/deploy-local.sh --check` reports `✓  mcp: adv-advance registered`
  on a config that has the entry, and `✗` with the expected URL on a config that
  does not.
- `bash scripts/deploy-local.sh --fix --dry-run` against a missing entry emits
  the patch summary and the JSONC fail-loud restore hint (no auto-rewrite).
- Plain-JSON configs (rare) get auto-patched with the standard entry.
- `shellcheck` clean on the edited regions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: Two new constants `ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME` and `ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL` defined
  near the existing path constants, with a comment citing the Tier-4 read surface
  and port 6298.
- AC2: `check_config()` emits a `✓` line when `.mcp.adv-advance.url` matches
  `$ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL`, and a `✗` line with the expected URL otherwise, bumping
  `config_issues` on failure.
- AC3: `fix_config()` includes a patch step that inserts the entry when missing,
  before the JSONC fail-loud branch, and emits a `patches_summary` line.
- AC4: JSONC fail-loud path is unchanged — operator gets a manual-edit restore
  hint; jq never rewrites the live JSONC file.
- AC5: `shellcheck scripts/deploy-local.sh` reports no new warnings on edited
  regions.
- AC6: Live opencode.jsonc (which already has the entry) is NOT mutated by this
  change — only the deploy script is edited.

## Constraints

- Follow the existing `plugin` array check/patch pattern exactly (lines 831 and
  1142 of pre-edit deploy-local.sh).
- No new spec deltas; this is a deploy-script operational improvement.
- No mutation of the live opencode.jsonc.
- No vision config or MCP server artifact changes.
- Preserve the JSONC fail-loud policy — jq-driven rewrites of live JSONC stay
  forbidden.

## Avoidances

- Do not add a separate JSONC-aware rewriter (existing policy is fail-loud).
- Do not register other MCP servers (context7/exa/etc.) — those are not
  owned by Advance.
- Do not remove or rewrite existing checks/patches.

## Out of Scope

- Defining a deprecation path for the bridge (still TEMPORARY_BRIDGE).
- Editing any other script, doc, or config file.
- Mutating the live config or any vision config.
documents.design:
# Design

## Architecture

Pure shell-script extension. No workflow, no runtime, no spec deltas. Two
constant additions, one new check block in `check_config()`, one new patch
block in `fix_config()`.

## Constants

Insert after the existing `ADV_INSTRUCTION_PATH` definition (around line 173 of
pre-edit `scripts/deploy-local.sh`):

```bash
# ADV MCP server (Tier-4 read surface, addAdvMcpReadSurface). The opencode.jsonc
# mcp block registers the vision-proxied HTTP endpoint so `tools.adv.*` reads
# resolve in Code Mode. Port 6298 per DDC1 (avoids episode=6297, lgrep=6278).
ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME="adv-advance"
ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL="http://localhost:6298/mcp"
```

## check_config() extension

Insert after the existing plugin-array check (around line 837), before the
instructions check:

```bash
# Validate adv-advance MCP registration (Tier-4 read surface)
if jq -e --arg name "$ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME" \
       --arg url "$ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL" \
    '(.mcp // {}) | if type == "object" then has($name) and (.[$name].url // "") == $url else false end' \
    <(jsonc_to_json "$GLOBAL_JSON") &>/dev/null; then
    echo "    ✓  mcp: $ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME registered (Tier-4 read surface)"
else
    echo "    ✗  mcp: $ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME entry missing or URL mismatch in .mcp"
    echo "       Expected: .mcp.$ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME.url = \"$ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL\""
    ((config_issues++)) || true
fi
```

Notes:
- Reads from `<(jsonc_to_json "$GLOBAL_JSON")` so JSONC syntax is normalized
  before jq inspects it (matches the pattern at line 823 for syntax validation
  and line 842 for the instructions check).
- `--arg` quotes the server name and URL safely; no shell interpolation into jq.

## fix_config() extension

Insert after the existing plugin-array patch (around line 1148), before the
instructions-removal patch:

```bash
# Add adv-advance MCP entry if missing or URL-drifted
if ! jq -e --arg name "$ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME" --arg url "$ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL" \
    '(.mcp // {}) | if type == "object" then has($name) and (.[$name].url // "") == $url else false end' \
    "$tmp_json" &>/dev/null; then
    jq --arg name "$ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME" --arg url "$ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL" \
        '.mcp = ((.mcp // {}) | . + {($name): {"type": "remote", "url": $url, "enabled": true}})' \
        "$tmp_json" >"$tmp_json.new" && mv "$tmp_json.new" "$tmp_json"
    patches_summary+="      + add mcp.$ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME (Tier-4 read surface, $ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL)"$'\n'
    ((patched++)) || true
fi
```

Notes:
- Uses `($name): {...}` so the server name is inserted as a key via jq's
  computed-key syntax (avoids literal-key quoting pitfalls).
- Merges into any existing `.mcp` object; preserves other entries.
- Operates on `$tmp_json` (the in-memory patch accumulator), so the JSONC
  fail-loud branch downstream handles the live-file-write policy unchanged.

## JSONC fail-loud path

Unchanged. When `$GLOBAL_JSON_IS_JSONC = true` and `patched > 0`, the existing
branch at line 1218 fires: backup, print summary, restore hint, return 1. The
new patch summary line is included automatically because it appends to the same
`patches_summary` variable.

## Verification plan

1. `bash scripts/deploy-local.sh --check` on the operator's live config (which
   has the entry) → emits the new `✓` line, no `config_issues` bump.
2. `bash scripts/deploy-local.sh --fix --dry-run` on a temp copy of the live
   config with `adv-advance` removed → emits the patch summary line and the
   JSONC fail-loud restore hint; no live file mutation.
3. `shellcheck scripts/deploy-local.sh` → no new warnings on edited regions.
4. `bash -n scripts/deploy-local.sh` → syntax parse clean.

## Error handling

Standard deploy-local.sh pattern: errors in patch logic surface as
`config_issues` increments in `check_config()` or as `patched` increments in
`fix_config()` (which then routes to JSONC fail-loud or JSON auto-patch). No
new error paths introduced.

# Executive Summary

## Outcome

The `adv-advance` MCP registration that was manually added to `opencode.jsonc` by
`refreshConcordInventory` (PR #110 in toolbox) is now durable against future
Advance plugin re-deploys. `scripts/deploy-local.sh` validates the entry via
`check_config()` and emits the exact patch via `fix_config()`, following the
existing pattern used for the plugin path, instructions, and legacy agent keys.

Three additions, one file, 29 insertions:

- `ADV_MCP_SERVER_NAME` / `ADV_MCP_SERVER_URL` constants (port 6298, matching
  the vision-proxied server registered in `~/.config/vision/servers.yaml`).
- `check_config()` jq predicate: `✓` when `.mcp.adv-advance.url` matches,
  `✗` with the expected URL otherwise.
- `fix_config()` jq patch: inserts the entry when missing or URL-drifted, before
  the existing JSONC fail-loud branch.

## Why It Matters

Without this, any future opencode.jsonc rewrite (fresh install, host migration,
manual edit, or plugin re-deploy that touches config) would silently drop the
`adv-advance` entry. Tier-4 `tools.adv.*` Code Mode reads would resume failing
with "Unknown tool" and the only signal would be agent-side errors at use time.
The deploy script now catches this at deploy time and either auto-patches (plain
JSON) or fails loud with the exact manual edit and restore hint (JSONC).

## Verification

- `bash -n scripts/deploy-local.sh` — syntax clean.
- `shellcheck 0.10.0` — no new warnings on edited regions (constants L175-179,
  check L845-854, patch L1169-1178); all pre-existing warnings on untouched lines.
- `bash scripts/deploy-local.sh --check` against live config — emits
  `✓  mcp: adv-advance registered (Tier-4 read surface)`.
- TDD red (run `tr_ms3vc3al_d546588b`): jq predicate correctly rejects a stripped
  fixture (`exit 1`).
- TDD green (run `tr_ms3vbkfs_973b94e7`): predicate accepts live config, rejects
  stripped fixture, and the patch correctly restores the entry to the stripped
  fixture.
- Diff: 1 file changed, 29 insertions, 0 deletions.
- Contract review matrix: 21/21 rows passing or respected; 0 failures.

## Release Readiness Summary

Pure shell-script extension to `scripts/deploy-local.sh`. No product runtime
change, no spec delta, no workflow mutation. Release requires only git
publication of the single edited file. The JSONC fail-loud policy is preserved
verbatim; the new check/patch rides the existing pattern.

## Remaining Risks and Follow-ups

- `shellcheck` is not installed on the operator host by default; CI may or may
  not enforce it. The static check was run from a /tmp-installed binary for this
  verification.
- The port 6298 is a magic number shared with vision config; if vision reassigns
  the port, the constant in deploy-local.sh must be updated in lockstep.
- Bridge deprecation path remains undefined (`registerAdvAdvanceMcpServer` is
  still classified `TEMPORARY_BRIDGE` in the Concord inventory).
- The pre-existing `tool drift: 69 tools registered but NOT in adv.md allowlist`
  finding from the live --check run is unrelated to this change and was not
  addressed.
